provenance_of_terms.note: Unlike its two predecessors this contract is NOT a pure extraction, and says so. The frozen record named the RULE and the TIE-BREAK but never defined the candidate set, the comparison operator or the F2 formula. Those three gaps were audited and reported, and a human supervisor has now supplied them. Recording that honestly is the point: the supplied terms are a decision, not a rule that was always there.

authorized_input.columns_source: the committed header row of the pinned input; no value was read by this contract lock
authorized_input.final_test_rows_in_input_note: The pooled development OOF surface is by construction development-only. TD03 re-proves it at derivation time rather than assuming it.

candidate_set.definition: exactly the distinct values present in the predicted_probability column of the filtered input

objective.name: F2
objective.library_substitution_note: The closed form is binding rather than advisory. A library call that agrees numerically is acceptable only as a CHECK; the recorded value must come from the stated expression.

selection.primary_criterion: highest F2 over the candidate set
selection.tie_break_criterion: among all candidates attaining the maximum F2, select the LARGEST numeric threshold

numeric_discipline.output_precision_test: float(str(value)) == value must hold for the recorded threshold

reasons: it is referenced by zero merged contracts and is not imported by the locked development pipeline
its candidate set is a 200-point linear grid unioned with the observed probabilities and synthetic 0.0/1.0 endpoints, none of which any contract fixes
its grid_points value is a default function argument rather than a contract term
its ascending scan keeps the FIRST maximizing candidate, which is the LOWEST, and therefore contradicts the locked higher_threshold tie-break

expected_outputs.note: These are the artifacts a future, separately authorized derivation would produce. NONE exists yet and none is produced by this contract lock.

artifacts.name: threshold_value_artifact
artifacts.description: the single selected threshold at round-trip-exact precision, with its F2, confusion counts and candidate-set size

artifacts.name: threshold_derivation_provenance_record
artifacts.description: input SHA-256, row filter and counts, runtime versions, and the algorithm terms actually applied

artifacts.name: threshold_derivation_qc_report
artifacts.description: results for every fail-closed control listed below, plus the counters block

artifacts.name: threshold_derivation_hash_manifest
artifacts.description: SHA-256 and byte count for every file in the derivation package

required_counters.note: A future derivation MUST report every counter below. 'REPORT' means the execution reports the observed number.

fail_closed_controls.check: the input file SHA-256 equals the pinned 48a00c88...3326749 and its byte count equals 214784
rows are filtered to model_family=regularized_logistic_regression and configuration_id=logistic__C_0.1, and the filtered row count equals the pinned 421
every filtered row has target_year in 1393-1399 and zero rows have target_year in 1400-1402
the candidate set equals the distinct predicted_probability values of the filtered rows exactly, with no grid, no synthetic endpoints, no midpoints and no thinning
the positive prediction uses predicted_probability >= threshold; strict greater-than is never used
F2 is computed as 5*TP / (5*TP + 4*FN + FP) on integer confusion counts, and equals 0 when the denominator is 0
no probability and no F2 value is rounded or truncated at any point before selection
among all candidates attaining the maximum F2 the LARGEST numeric threshold is selected, and this is verified against the full argmax set rather than assumed from scan order
project/src/metrics.py::pick_threshold is neither imported nor called, and no other unpinned threshold helper is used
exactly one threshold is selected and recorded; no alternative threshold is promoted as a sensitivity or robustness result
model_fits_executed == 0, refits_executed == 0 and predict_proba_calls == 0; the derivation reads stored predictions and loads no model
target states follow the frozen target_state_contract, missing is never counted as negative, and only evaluable rows enter the confusion counts
the locked development results are byte-identical before and after the derivation
the recorded threshold satisfies float(str(value)) == value, so the stored value round-trips exactly
runtime versions equal the locked development runtime exactly
final_test_rows_read == 0 and no Final Test row, predictor, target or prediction is loaded, read or produced
the derivation writes no file outside its own package and edits no historical or frozen artifact
no recalibration, bootstrap, SHAP, p-value, confidence interval or model re-selection is executed

relationship_to_the_final_test_contract.this_lock_resolves_pre02_note: PRE02 requires the threshold VALUE to exist in a committed artifact. This action defines the algorithm that would produce it and computes nothing, so PRE02 remains UNRESOLVED. Defining how a number would be produced is not producing it.

final_test_boundary.input_header_note: Only the committed header row and the file's SHA-256 and byte count were read. No predicted_probability or observed_target value was read.
